name: model-advisor
description: Classifies a session's first prompt with Jev and, when it needs a stronger model than the session is on, offers to switch with /model and resend

autoSwitch.title: Switch without asking
autoSwitch.description: On a confident upgrade, run /model and resend the prompt at once instead of offering the choice above the prompt.

downgrade.title: Suggest cheaper models too
downgrade.description: Also advise when a cheaper tier looks enough. Off: upgrades only.

quiet.title: Hide silent verdicts
quiet.description: Off: when the advisor stays silent it still shows its verdict in the status line (and, from a phone or the web, at the top of the reply).
